## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) and follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or API changed
- [ ] Changeset added (published packages only)
- [ ] Works on Windows, Linux and macOS
- [ ] No secrets, private links or internal planning content
